fields.value: EIB is a leading Islamic bank in UAE which provides Islamic banking services to its clients. Emirates Islamic bank has acquired Dubai bank and as part of this acquisition the entire Dubai bank portfolio is migrated from Dubai bank system BankMaster to EIB banking solution Equation, Quaestor and FinnOne systems. Led the end-to-end technology integration of Dubai Bank into Emirates Islamic Bank following the strategic acquisition, providing leadership across migration planning, execution, cutover and post-implementation stabilization. Collaborated closely with business, technology, operations and vendor teams to ensure seamless migration of Core Banking, Lending and Wealth Management platforms while maintaining business continuity and minimizing operational risk
